title: Kitty Kingdom and the Robot Menace
author: dgeisert
selftext:
I made a fun tower defence game as part of a hackathon and got the 'Most Fun' rating.  I decided to take the game further and fully develop it.  I would greatly appreciate any feedback anyone cares to give!

Read about the process of taking the jam game to a full game:  
[https://dgeisert.itch.io/kittykingdom/devlog/1744370/from-jam-game-to-full-game](https://dgeisert.itch.io/kittykingdom/devlog/1744370/from-jam-game-to-full-game)

Join us in doing AI based game jams:  
[https://jamference.com](https://jamference.com)

replies.author: dgeisert
replies.body: I like cats, and I have two cats.  I don't have foxes or bunnies or dogs or llamas.  They also have a good coloration variety without needing to do sizing and form changes like would be needed with dogs.

replies.author: dgeisert
replies.body: Also the theme of the jam was "Cats and Robots"
